title: Personalized RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models with Human Aligned Personalization
authors_zh: Qiyao Ma、Dechen Gao、Rui Cai、Boqi Zhao、Hanchu Zhou、Junshan Zhang、Zhe Zhao
best_for_zh: 需要评测个体化偏好建模、用户条件化奖励模型或多元价值对齐的研究者
one_line: Personalized RewardBench isolates user-specific rubric adherence in chosen–rejected pairs to test whether reward models genuinely model individual preferences.
数据以用户专属量规构造 chosen/rejected 对，隔离个体偏好变量，并验证其可预测 BoN 与 PPO 下游表现。
why: It controls general answer quality so the discriminative signal is the user's own rubric rather than a generic preference proxy.
inclusion_reason: Personalized RewardBench supplies public preference pairs and evaluations for human-aligned, user-specific reward modeling.

title: Problem
问题
html:
General RewardBench-style evaluations assume one universally best answer, while real users may prefer particular levels of concision, tone, structure, or values. If candidate responses also differ substantially in correctness or helpfulness, an RM can succeed without understanding personalization.

Personalized RewardBench supplies an explicit user-specific rubric for each example and constructs two generally high-quality responses that respectively follow or violate it, making the preference distinction depend primarily on the individual requirement.

通用 RewardBench 假设所有用户共享一个“最好回答”，但真实用户可能偏好简洁、特定语气、结构或价值取向。若正负回答还同时在正确性和帮助性上差异明显，就无法判断奖励模型是否真的理解个人偏好。

Personalized RewardBench 为每个样本显式提供用户专属 rubric，并构造两条总体质量都较高、但分别遵守或违反该 rubric 的回答，使偏好差异尽量只由个体要求决定。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Personalized RewardBench supplies an explicit user-specific rubric for each example and constructs two generally high-quality responses that respectively follow or violate it, making the preference distinction depend primarily on the individual requirement. The official release contains roughly 2.83K personalized-preference instances. Core fields include the request, user rubric, chosen and rejected responses, and labels. Construction controls correctness, relevance, and helpfulness so that adherence to the personal preference is the main difference, and human review checks this isolation condition.

Personalized RewardBench 为每个样本显式提供用户专属 rubric，并构造两条总体质量都较高、但分别遵守或违反该 rubric 的回答，使偏好差异尽量只由个体要求决定。官方数据页约有 2.83K 个个性化偏好实例；核心字段包括原始请求、用户 rubric、chosen 与 rejected 回答及标签。构造时控制两回答的正确性、相关性和帮助性，使其主要差别是是否遵守专属偏好；人类评审用于确认该隔离条件。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Collect requests that admit multiple reasonable preferences and define a clear, decidable personal rubric for each request.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Generate two generally high-quality candidates, one strictly following the rubric and the other violating only the target personalization condition without obvious factual errors.
  1. Verify and filter: Have humans verify that personal preference is the discriminating factor and remove pairs with general-quality differences or ambiguous isolation.
  1. Train and evaluate: Evaluate pairwise RM accuracy and test predictive validity against downstream Best-of-N and PPO performance of the same RMs.

1. 建立数据源： 收集可表达多种合理偏好的用户请求，并为每个请求定义明确、可判定的个人 rubric。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 生成两条总体质量均高的候选，使一条严格遵守 rubric，另一条只违反目标个性化条件而不引入明显事实错误。
  1. 验证与筛选： 由人工比较候选，确认区分因素确为个人偏好；不满足隔离条件或存在普遍质量差异的样本被删除。
  1. 训练与评测： 评测现有 RM 的 pairwise accuracy，并用同一 RM 在 Best-of-N 与 PPO 中的下游表现检验 benchmark 预测效度。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Human evaluation confirms that both candidates retain high correctness, relevance, and helpfulness and are distinguished mainly by the personal rubric. The best existing RM reaches only 75.94% accuracy. Compared with general benchmarks, this benchmark correlates more strongly with actual RM performance in Best-of-N and PPO, supporting its use as a personalization proxy. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.
人类评审确认两候选都保持较高的正确性、相关性和帮助性，主要差别来自个人 rubric。现有最佳奖励模型准确率也只有 75.94%；相较通用基准，该 benchmark 与 RM 在 Best-of-N 和 PPO 中的实际表现具有更高相关性，支持其作为个性化下游代理。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior personalization evaluations often mix user profiles, factual quality, and style differences. This benchmark makes the user rubric an explicit condition and constructs a high-quality-but-not-for-me hard negative, isolating personalization as the evaluated variable.
已有个性化评价常把用户画像、事实质量和风格差异混在一起；本文的关键变化是用用户 rubric 作为显式条件，并设计“高质量但不符合我”的 hard negative，从而隔离 personalization 这一变量。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: Rubrics are explicit text rather than long-term implicit user histories and do not fully represent preference drift or real personalization.
  1. Feedback risk: Synthetic candidates may retain subtle general-quality differences; human verification reduces but cannot eliminate confounding.
  1. Reproduction and use: Cross-task consistency of a user preference may be underrepresented, so single-turn pairs do not establish long-term satisfaction.

1. 覆盖边界： rubric 是明确文本而非长期隐式用户历史，不能完全代表真实个性化建模和偏好漂移。
  1. 反馈风险： 合成候选可能仍含细微总体质量差异，人工确认只能降低而不能消除混杂。
  1. 复现与使用： 同一用户偏好在不同任务中的一致性未必被覆盖，不能从单轮 pair 推断长期满意度。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Evaluate whether rubric-conditioned RMs can perform user-specific ranking among otherwise strong responses.
  1. Training: Train personalized RMs with the rubric as input while mixing general-quality data to avoid overfitting one style.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Use the benchmark for offline model selection before BoN or PPO and report both personalization accuracy and general-quality regression.

1. 评测： 评测 rubric-conditioned RM 是否能在高质量回答之间执行用户特定排序。
  1. 训练： 训练个性化 reward model 时把 rubric 作为输入，并使用通用质量数据防止过拟合单一风格。
  1. 迁移或部署： 在 BoN 或 PPO 前做离线模型选择；成功标准应同时报告个性化准确率和通用质量回退。
